concept.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. PREVIEW CONCEPT ART SHEET ONLY for Kiba Realms, a richly painted Japanese fantasy 2D side-scroller, NOT a production sprite atlas. Use image1 (lava serpent atlas) strictly as the established serpent anatomy/material-detail/outline reference; do NOT redesign or reproduce the lava serpent. Image2 (Momo shiba) is ONLY the painted game-character art style reference, not a character to insert. Image3 is the existing celestial architecture/light reference. Create one cohesive, text-free, widescreen concept board divided into clear spacious panels on a dark indigo/parchment artist-board background. TOP TWO LARGE PANELS: left one complete enormous ivory-white Japanese sacred serpent, one head, long S-curved neck, compact coiled body, complete tapered tail, cool jade eyes, subtle pale jade scale recesses, ivory cheek plates/fins, no hands/legs/wings, elegant dangerous readable silhouette; right one complete large celestial corrupted winged serpent, exactly one head and one pair of feathered wings, long coiled navy-violet and ivory scaled body with antique gold plates, gold eye, white feathers with subtly violet-dark tips and cracks of shadow energy, complete wings/tail inside panel. Detailed tactile scales, fierce elegant Japanese folklore anatomy, inked dark contours and painterly shading matching existing game. They must be recognizably members of the lava serpent family but with independent silhouettes. Both face LEFT, and sit on a clear shared baseline within their own panel, full silhouette with ample margins, no giant external glow obscuring limbs or anatomy. MIDDLE TWO HORIZONTAL ENVIRONMENT PANELS: left a hidden natural limestone cavern beside ancient Japanese cult ruins, muted cool jade water reflections, collapsed shrine stone, weathered ropes and moss, atmospheric detailed dark background, continuous level ledge and cave floor suitable for a side-scroller; right a celestial ruin far to the east in bright clouds, ivory stone terrace, ruined gold-trim arches, feather motifs, dark violet corruption staining some stone, strong darker silhouette edges and readable floor. No bosses/NPCs drawn into environment panels, no enemies. BOTTOM THREE DISTINCT LARGE ITEM STUDIES: one broad white-ivory shed serpent scale with cool jade center and dark readable rim; one broad celestial navy-violet scale with antique gold rim and tiny ivory feather filigree; one single wearable Japanese talisman pendant, three clearly distinct overlapping scales (ivory-jade, obsidian-ember, navy-violet-gold) bound inside an antique-gold circular clasp with a restrained red silk cord. Pendant has compact cohesive silhouette, no extra scales, no human parts. All items opaque, saturated, dark edged for readability on a dark inventory, no translucent low-contrast fog. Rich careful painted Japanese fantasy quality, not flat vector, not primitive shapes, not pixel art, not photoreal product imagery. No text, typography, names, numbers, labels, watermark, captions, UI, attacks or animation arrows. Sheet is for visual-direction approval and must feel like the exact game family.
concept.notes: Complete single-head limbless serpent bodies; celestial variant has one feathered wing pair. Three item studies: white scale, winged scale, talisman binding white/lava/celestial scales. Environments are direction previews, not collision geometry.
